notes.title: Disc Golf Masters – From the Creators of Disc Golf Valley
notes.content:
If you’ve played Disc Golf Valley, you know what’s coming next.

We’re proud to finally announce Disc Golf Masters – a brand new disc golf game for PC and consoles, developed by Spin-Off Games and published by Bonus Stage.

[b]This is a full-featured disc golf sim with:

[/b]• Real-world-inspired courses
• Licensed discs from Latitude 64°, Discmania, Westside Discs, and Kastaplast
• Pro athletes
• Career mode
• Online and local multiplayer
• Leagues, progression, and deep customization

It’s everything we’ve wanted to build — and it’s coming first to Early Access on Steam.

💬 Join the official Discord for updates, playtest info, and to talk with the devs:
[url= https://discord.gg/VYDHVrs3S8]Disc Golf Masters Discord[/url]


➡️ Wishlist now to get notified when it drop

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819400/Disc_Golf_Masters/
